scenes.name: Southern-pine basement (memory)

lines.text: Coming of age in the shared rooms of human basements
as bedrooms,
mattress pads where the wood beams
of southern pine could comfort my spine,
it didn't.
To dream was to prevail.

lines.text: Their blood flows through my hands.
Fingerprints that orchestra great powers,
they tell me, sun kissing my skin
and deepening my voice to a baritone of a million cries,
to an unanswered plight.
Beware of me.
